property_summary: For any caller whose supportsToken() returns the expected hash, a successful airDrop grants exactly 20 tokens (tokenBalance becomes 20); the mutant grants 30, so reading c.tokenBalance(actor) after a successful airDrop distinguishes P from M for every admissible input.
change_summary: Increase the airdrop amount from 20 to 30, so balances after airDrop() differ from the original.
